name: Maintenance dispatcher
design: Broad adult male with olive-grey reptilian hide, flattened wide brow and short mandibles, dreadlocks cropped at shoulders. Sleeveless black canvas officer vest with deep front pockets and one large copper circular collar clip, thick brown belt and short heavy apron, practical cloth leg wraps. Left hand holds a folded compact diagnostic probe, right hand grips a small utility ring with three chunky coupling keys; no armor or gun.
